stem: The number of sports injuries per month at a certain college has a Poisson distribution. In the past the mean has been 1.1 injuries per month. The principal recently introduced new safety guidelines and she decides to test, at the 2% significance level, whether the mean number of sports injuries has been reduced. She notes the number of sports injuries during a 6-month period.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the critical region for the test and state the probability of a Type I error.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: State what is meant by a Type I error in this context.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: During the 6-month period there are a total of 2 sports injuries. Carry out the test.

parts.label: (iv)
parts.text: Assuming that the mean remains 1.1, calculate the probability that there will be fewer than 30 sports injuries during a 36-month period.
